summary: Follow-up static RE corrects the earlier model: xdbboxr.adf has 121 fields and 37 records, not 121 records and 37 fields. The fixed header is 24 bytes; a 31-byte packed 2-bit-per-field type map begins at +0x18; the row matrix begins at +0x38 with a 0xF2-byte stride. Identity, stock-roster availability, hometown, nickname/alias, weight/division, and the core rating block are now mapped. Many appearance/equipment/career fields remain unresolved.

container.refpack_decode: clean: exact declared-size match, zero RefPack trailing bytes

field_count.evidence: func_001ACCAC bounds field_id against header[0]; func_001AD268 scans exactly header[0] 2-bit field-type codes.

record_count.evidence: func_001AD21C returns header[1]; func_001AD180 bounds record_index against header[1] and computes row = matrix_base + record_index*(field_count*2).

header.note: Bytes at +0x18 and +0x1C are not header words: +0x18 starts the packed field-type bitmap and +0x38 begins the aligned row matrix in xdbboxr.

field_type_table.layout: 2 bits per field, four fields per byte; field shift = 6 - ((field_id & 3)*2)

native_types.0: inline signed int16 stored directly in the row token
native_types.1: byte/string pool at payload + string_pool_base + signed16 token
native_types.2: int32 pool at payload + int32_pool_base + signed16(token)*4
native_types.3: float32 pool at payload + float_pool_base + signed16(token)*4

record_descriptor_matrix.evidence: func_001AD180 computes the matrix base as word2 - align4(field_count*record_count*2), then advances by field_count*2 per record. For xdbboxr the result is 0x38 and the padded matrix ends exactly at word2=0x2334.

roster_count_correction.finding: 121 is the XDB field/column count, not the boxer-record count. xdbboxr.adf contains 37 base rows/records in the tracked retail resource.
roster_count_correction.selector_model: func_00186284 resolves the boxer selector/index by cumulative registered-table record counts. It never consults xdbboxr field 0: it subtracts each table's dynamic record_count and passes the residual record index to func_001AD180.
roster_count_correction.select_boxer_context: The normal stock SelectBoxer range table exposes selector indices 0-34 across six divisions. Base rows/indexes 35 and 36 are bonus/hidden records for Fabolous and Little Mac.
roster_count_correction.field0_correction: xdbboxr field 0 happens to equal row index for rows 0-34 but contains 74 and 75 in rows 35 and 36. Because the actual selector resolver reaches those records by cumulative indices 35 and 36 without reading field 0, field 0 is NOT the global SelectBoxer/fight-session boxer index. Its exact secondary/resource-ID role remains unresolved.
roster_count_correction.hard_maximum: No hard total roster maximum is established. Base record_count is dynamic and func_00186284 can span multiple registered boxer-table instances.

func_001B0FE8 returns true immediately when field4 > 0. When field4 == 0, selector index 35 is conditionally accepted through a per-boxer bit in the session/object bitset beginning at +0x1C4; indices >=36 are rejected in that predicate.
T_001B2648 can set the corresponding +0x1C4 availability bit using func_001AF728, which splits a selector index into word=index/32 and bit=index%32.
selection_flag.conclusion: Field 0x04 is the default/base availability flag. Normal stock boxers pass directly; at least bonus selector index 35 can be promoted to available by a separate runtime/session unlock bit. This is stronger than the earlier stock-list-only interpretation.

career_timing_fields.confidence: PROBABLE semantic labels; CONFIRMED bit extraction/arithmetic
executable_corroboration: func_00197DAC reads the high-byte accessor as a calendar year and rejects entries whose start year is later than the current simulated year.
The same function combines the low byte with the start year as start_year - start_age + 39, i.e. the calendar year in which the boxer reaches age 39, and uses that threshold in career-era filtering.
Decoded retail rows match real boxer career timing strongly enough to support the semantic labels: e.g. Ali encodes 1960/18, Frazier 1965/21, Holyfield 1984/22 and Roy Jones Jr 1989/20.
career_timing_fields.note: Some retail rows appear to contain reused or imperfect historical values, so this records the engine meaning of the packed fields rather than asserting historical accuracy for every boxer.

behavior: func_001857E4 reads field 0x0F after resolving rating fields 0x10-0x18.
When field 0x0F != 0, func_001857E4 returns the selected raw rating (or derived Power/Overall slot) clamped to 10..100.
When field 0x0F == 0, func_001857E4 obtains the boxer's weight class through func_0018600C and scales the selected rating through D_FLT_0055E280 before clamping it to 10..100.
T_00187434 only populates its nine-rating output through func_001857E4 when field 0x0F == 0 and marks output +0x78 = 1.
func_00187548 takes the complementary path: when field 0x0F != 0 it fills the nine-rating output with the unscaled/base accessor func_0018553C and marks output +0x78 = 0.
rating_mode_field_0x0F.conclusion: Field 0x0F selects between the game's weight-class-adjusted rating path and an alternate/raw rating mode. The underlying boxer category that sets the flag is not yet proven, so it is intentionally not named 'created', 'career', or similar.
